LanguageData.CC_SetSec_Direction_Note: One of Rimfolk's fourteen ways to play, leaning whichever storyteller you play. With one of Rimfolk's as your storyteller, it plays its own way unless a direction is chosen here.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_StoryDirection_Tip: Leans the storyteller you play toward one of Rimfolk's fourteen ways to play. It shapes Rimfolk's own happenings (visitors, joiners, animals, finds, feasts, performers, camps, letters, favours, calls to arms, missions, world situations, friends in a fight) and who a raid comes from. The storyteller keeps its own pace of threats and sickness. It shifts the odds toward something but shuts nothing out: every kind of event can still come. It can be changed at any time, in a running game too.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection: Leans any storyteller toward one of the fourteen ways to play.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_None: No lean: the storyteller plays as it does (one of Rimfolk's plays its own way).
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_LongRoad: More letters, favours asked, camps, missions and word from the region.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_Neighbours: Raids mostly come from a people with a reason; more visitors, letters, favours and friends.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_TurningYear: Camps, trade, visitors, letters and fights follow the year: busy autumns, hard winters.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_WhatYouSow: The peoples remember more; kindness brings visitors and friends and fewer fights, and cruelty keeps travelers away.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_OldPowers: More pilgrims and seers, strange nights, signs in the land and sky, and news of strange skies; fewer fights.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_LeanYears: Fewer traders, visitors, camps and fights; the region's news turns to famine, drought and hard winters.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_RiseAndFall: Two-year cycles: a busy year of growth, then a year of trouble foretold by the region's news, ending in the rebuilding.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_Crossroads: More traders, camps, visitors, favours and debts; some raids come from rivals with a grudge.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_OpenGate: More of Rimfolk's events in which someone may join, and more visitors.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_HomeAndHearth: Personal stories about twice as often; more pasts catching up, challenges, wagers, feasts and games.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_TheWilds: More of Rimfolk's animal and land events, more moments with animals, and news of herds and beasts.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_Windfalls: More of Rimfolk's finds and gifts: treasure maps, caches, crates, old vaults; news of wrecks and vaults.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_Sellswords: More calls to arms, champions, bounties and sellswords for hire; news of sellsword companies.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_StoryDirection_FeastDays: More feasts, fairs, games, performers and storytellers; news of fairs, moots, bumper harvests and songs.
